cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - << 'EOF'
import subprocess, sys, json, time, resource, os, tempfile
payloads = [
    b'{"services":["a"],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"true"}}],"queries":[["a"]]}',
    b'\xff\xfe\xfa',
    b'',
    b'   ',
    b'[' * 200,
    b'{"services":["a","a"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}',
    b'{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[]}',
    b'{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[]}extra',
    b'\xc3\x28',
    b'{"services":["\xed\xa0\x80"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}',
    b'{"services":["a"],"rules":[],"queries":[["a"]],"x":1e400}',
    b'{"services":["a"],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"and","args":[]}}],"queries":[[]]}',
]
payload = b'\n'.join(payloads) + b'\n'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as cwd:
    t0 = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                       input=payload, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=cwd)
    el = time.time() - t0
ru = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print('rc=%d elapsed=%.2fs maxrss=%.1fMB stderr=%r' % (p.returncode, el, ru.ru_maxrss/1024, p.stderr[:200]))
out = p.stdout.decode().split('\n')
assert out[-1] == ''
out = out[:-1]
print('lines out:', len(out))
for line in out:
    print('  ', line[:110])
EOF
